I am writing this review 15-20 days after my treatment to give an honest assessment of the results. On February 14th, I visited for a Hair Smoothening + Botox treatment, for which I was charged ₹13,000 (including a shampoo and conditioner set). Unfortunately, this has been a total waste of money.
This isn’t my first time getting these treatments, so I know what the results should look like. Despite paying a premium price:
• No Visible Difference: There is absolutely no difference between this high-end service and the basic "offer" treatments I’ve had previously.

• Chemical Odor: My hair has smelled strongly of chemicals for the last 14 days. Even the "professional" shampoo provided (worth ₹3,200) has a harsh chemical scent that is very unpleasant.

• Unprofessional Service: I spent 6 hours there. The staff seemed confused about the process—initially telling me to come back in two days for second wash, then suddenly deciding to leave the chemicals product in my hair overnight because it was getting late.

• Poor Value for Money: Two years ago, I had a kerasmoothening treatment at their Nahur branch for just ₹3,000 including products, and the results were far superior with no chemical smell. This time, I paid four times more for a much worse experience.

I waited two weeks to see if the results would improve, but they haven't. I am extremely disappointed and feel that the service did not match the price tag at all.

I have already done nanoplastia before and I already use suitable shampoo and conditioner, so forcing customers to buy extra products afterwards is unfair and misleading.

What disappointed me even more was the behavior of the staff member Ashwini. Instead of properly listening to my concern, she started arguing and even said, “Ma’am insano ki tarah baat karo.” I would like the management to explain what exactly that means and whether this is the kind of language staff are trained to use with customers.

After repeatedly requesting support, they finally asked me to visit again to “check and decide.” Today when I visited, the staff claimed they were doing a redo treatment, but they only worked on a small damaged section, applied spa, and did a blow dry. Then they said, “See ma’am, straight ho gaya.” Customers are not fools — anyone knows hair can temporarily look straight after a blow dry.

Very unprofessional handling, poor customer service, and disappointing results overall. I expected honesty and proper resolution instead of arguments and temporary fixes.

I also tried reaching out to the manager on the contact number provided on Instagram, but no one answered the call, which made the entire experience even more frustrating

Would not recommend.
